description: Calculate one scenario through the WorkbookAPI hosted API. Sends the model id and the input values, output names and as_of value given. Inputs and outputs use declared interface names. Returns the API outputs, warnings, request_id and billed_scenarios unchanged. Bills 1 scenario on success. Dates are serial numbers in the workbook's date system. A lost response may still be billed; this server never retries automatically.

as_of.description: Calculation moment: YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339 date-time with offset; omitted uses today.

inputs.description: Declared input names mapped to scalar values; omitted inputs keep their saved values.

model_id.description: Hosted model id returned by upload_model.

outputs.description: Declared output names; omitted selects all declared outputs.

name: calculate
